body: The shovel and scrub bucket are tied together with torn warning tape. A yellow tag with only a number hangs from the knot. A stamp is smudged on the bucket.
title: Hand shovel and bucket

body: A farm truck carried sacks from the test plot, with yellow dust on the seams. A torn sack left a stripe across the dirt road, and the grass where it fell had withered by evening.
title: Notepad page
